description:
Partial share of the freehold - No service charges! NO CHAIN! A spacious and well presented two bedroom ground floor apartment in the highly sought after Hull Marina. Ideally located within walking distance of shops, restaurants, bars and excellent transport links, this move in ready home benefits from private parking, gas central heating and double glazing. Featuring a bright open plan living/kitchen area, private rear yard and front terrace, it is an ideal first home or investment opportunity.
